name: lightning storm
mana cost: {1}{R}{R}
types: instant
spell[1]: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target, where X is 3 plus the number of charge counters on CARDNAME.
activated[2]: discard a land card: put two charge counters on CARDNAME. you may choose a new target for it. any player may activate this ability but only if CARDNAME is on the stack.
